meta.title: Location-Source-Agnostic Visits & Discovery
meta.thesis: Every user-facing visit/discovery feature is decoupled from the 500ms streaming DO via a normalized LocationFix ingress. Sources: tessie-poll, phone (device_location), ai, manual, and the optional streaming DO. The stream is a fast-path source, not a dependency.
